eval_name: Functional testing: cut scope for a short window
prompt:
Use functional-testing. Features: login, search, checkout, payment, coupons, points, tickets, admin reports.
Half-day release window. Keep only critical paths and explain what can be deferred.
assertions: output_matches{all:[P0 (?i)(critical path|critical scenario|core flow|release gate) (?i)(defer|deferred|deferral|out of scope|not in this pass) (?i)risk]}
